# Load data for dates

```{r}
art_data <- read.delim("raw_data/artwork1.csv", colClasses = "character")

# parse out date, month, and year variables from existing columns
art_data <- art_data %>% 
  separate(dateEnd, c("yearEnd","monthEnd","dayEnd"), remove = FALSE) %>% 
  separate(dateStart, c("yearStart","monthStart","dayStart"), remove = FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(yearEnd = as.numeric(yearEnd),
         monthEnd = as.numeric(monthEnd),
         dayEnd = as.numeric(dayEnd),
         yearStart = as.numeric(yearStart),
         monthStart = as.numeric(monthStart),
         dayStart = as.numeric(dayStart))

# remove weird data (8 entries)
art_data <- art_data %>%
  filter(category != "25~26-March/1936") %>% # shifted column (fixable)
  filter(category != "") %>% # empty rows
  filter(yearEnd != 0) # 2 entries w/ missing end dates

# number of years to finish
art_data <- art_data %>%
  mutate(yearDuration = yearEnd - yearStart)

# fill months and dates
art_data <- art_data %>% 
  mutate(monthEnd_fix = case_when(monthEnd == 0 ~ 6.5,
                                  TRUE ~ monthEnd),
         dayEnd_fix = case_when(dayEnd == 0 ~ 15.5,
                                  TRUE ~ dayEnd),
         monthStart_fix = case_when(monthStart == 0 ~ 6.5,
                                  TRUE ~ monthStart),
         dayStart_fix = case_when(dayStart == 0 ~ 15.5,
                                  TRUE ~ dayStart)) %>%
  mutate(dateEnd = make_date(yearEnd, monthEnd_fix, dayEnd_fix), # convert dateEnd into date type
         dateStart = make_date(yearStart, monthStart_fix, dayStart_fix), # convert dateStart into date type
         yearMonthStart = yearStart + monthStart_fix/12 + dayStart_fix/365) %>% # convert date into year scale
  mutate(date_duration = dateEnd - dateStart)

# select necessary columns
reduced_art <- art_data %>% 
  select(opp, title, category, dayStart, monthStart, yearStart, yearMonthStart, dateStart)

paintings <- reduced_art %>% 
  filter(category == "painting")

exist_dates <- paintings %>% 
  filter(dateStart > '1900-01-01') %>% 
  arrange(dateStart) %>% 
  pull(dateStart) %>% 
  unique()
```


# Movement Functions

```{r, warning=FALSE}
fixed_dims <- 20 # number of starting and fixed dimensions
novel_dims <- 10 # number of novel dimensions
n_iter <- length(exist_dates)

# (n_iter/num_cycles)/1.25: tuning relative length between exploit vs explore
ars_step_fun <- function(dimn = 1, t = 1, n_iter = 1000, num_cycles = 3) {
  search_param <- case_when(dimn < 0 ~ 1,
                            (t %% (n_iter/num_cycles)) < 
                              ((n_iter/num_cycles)/1.25) ~ 0,
                            TRUE ~ 1)
  step_size <- rtruncnorm(1, a=0, b=1, mean=search_param, sd=0.05)
  direction <- ((-1)^rbinom(n=length(search_param), size=1, prob=0.5))
  return(step_size * direction)
}

constrict_step_fun <- function(dimn = 1, t = 1, dim_scale = 1, k = 1/10) {
  search_param <- case_when(dimn < 0 ~ 1,
                            TRUE ~ 1 - (1/(1 + exp(-k*(t - (dim_scale*dimn))))))
  step_size <- rtruncnorm(1, a=0, b=1, mean=search_param, sd=0.05)
  direction <- ((-1)^rbinom(n=length(search_param), size=1, prob=0.5))
  return(step_size * direction)
}

expand_step_fun <- function(dimn = 1, t = 1, dim_scale = 1, k = 1/10) {
  search_param <- case_when(dimn < 0 ~ 1,
                            TRUE ~ 1/(1 + exp(-k*(t - (dim_scale*dimn)))))
  step_size <- rtruncnorm(1, a=0, b=1, mean=search_param, sd=0.05)
  direction <- ((-1)^rbinom(n=length(search_param), size=1, prob=0.5))
  return(step_size * direction)
}
```


# Sliding window parameters

```{r}
# sliding window parameters
year_window <- 5

first_date <- ymd(19000101)
last_date <- ymd(19720701)

last_dense_date <- first_date + length(exist_dates)

# (last_date - first_date) / 365

window_size <- years(year_window)
wstep_size <- 1
wstep_unit <- "years"

sample.size <- 40
```


## Sliding Window Analysis

```{r}
states <- read_csv(file.path("results",
                             paste0("expand_search_empi_states.csv")))

ordered_pca <- states %>% 
  rename(target_date = dateStart) %>% 
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_pc"), contains("dim"))

slidw_df <- sliding_window_mvt(ordered_pca, first_date, last_date,
                               window_size, wstep_size, wstep_unit,
                               sample.size, sample.method = "first")

write_csv(slidw_df,
          file.path("results",
                    paste0("expand_search1y_empistp_first_summary.csv")))
```

# Batch run for Phase plot

```{r}
n_sim <- 25
mvt_model <- "ars"

# list to store results
mresult_list <- list(model = c(),
                     pratio_coef = c(),
                     pratio_se = c(),
                     burst = c(),
                     burst_se = c())

for (i in 1:n_sim) {
  states <- simulate_mvt(fixed_dims, novel_dims, exist_dates,
                         mvt_model = mvt_model, num_cycles = 40)
  
  ordered_pca <- states %>% 
    rename(target_date = dateStart) %>% 
    rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_pc"), contains("dim"))

  model_smry <- sliding_window_mvt(ordered_pca, first_date, last_date,
                                   window_size, wstep_size, wstep_unit,
                                   sample.size, sample.method = "first")
  
  model_mvt_trend <- model_smry %>% 
    select(start_date, cstep_avg, pratio) %>% 
    mutate(time_step = 1:nrow(model_smry),
           year = year(start_date))
  
  pratio_model <- lm(pratio ~ year, data = model_mvt_trend)
  pratio.slope <- pratio_model$coefficients[2]
  pratio.stderr <- summary(pratio_model)$coefficients[4]
  
  burst <- mean(model_smry$loc_burst)
  burst_se <- sd(model_smry$loc_burst)/sqrt(nrow(model_smry))
  
  mresult_list$model <- c(mresult_list$model, mvt_model)
  mresult_list$pratio_coef <- c(mresult_list$pratio_coef, pratio.slope)
  mresult_list$pratio_se <- c(mresult_list$pratio_se, pratio.stderr)
  
  mresult_list$burst <- c(mresult_list$burst, burst)
  mresult_list$burst_se <- c(mresult_list$burst_se, burst_se)
}

model_summary <- data.frame(mresult_list)
write_csv(model_summary,
          file.path("results",
                    paste0(mvt_model, "_phase_summary.csv")))
```
